decisions.decision: Drop the combined chips. Adi has no real figures to send, and the no-unsourced-numbers rule settles this. In app/src/components/masterclass/funnel-os.tsx, remove the stage totals 11.4K visits, 368 registrations and 3.2% CVR (around lines 97, 535, 865 and 1269), plus any leftover 179 or 6.89%. Do the same for the 368 and 11.4K totals next to regs '825' in funnel-visuals.tsx (around line 583). Keep only the Pro card figures (825 registrations, 9.6%), and only if they trace to the whiteboard source (reference/whiteboard-v12-text.txt). If they don't, remove them too. Where a stage needs a placeholder, use the stage label with no number. Don't add the word 'webinar' to the copy and don't rename 'Tantra Pro' (that's T-116). Then run git grep -n '368\|11.4K\|3.2%' on both files, re-run the FunnelOS shoot (scripts/shoot-engine.mjs), probe-workshop.mjs and probe-funnels.mjs, commit to main, publish the mirror and set the task to review for Bhaskar.
decisions.why: The task's own recommendation is to drop the chips. The masterclass-copy-bans and enterprise-voice rules ban unsourced stats. The 2026-09-25 handoff flagged the totals as older than the Basic removal. The orchestrator-autonomy rule (2026-10-09) says Claude makes this choice. 825 cannot exceed 368.

decisions.decision: The fix is already in the working tree: funnel-os.tsx now shows 8.6K visits, 825 registrations and 9.6%, all matching the Pro KPI block in reference/whiteboard-v12-text.txt (lines 298-321), and no 368 or 11.4K remains in funnel-os.tsx or funnel-visuals.tsx. Finish it. (1) Line 851 pairs 825 with 48.6% (which is 179 of 368) and outV 400, a count that is in no source. (4) Commit, push main, publish the mirror. (5) Log the source lines on T-117, clear the blocker and the ask of Adi, and set the task to review for Bhaskar.
